items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: In fact I had Jack play out at the Norris Country Club.

ctx.x: In fact I had Jack play out at the Norris Country Club. And he had a job earlier and I told him, I said don't worry, I'll play for a half hour until you get there. And I got out there for a half hour and believe me, he wasn't getting the same notes as I was. And I think I know what the notes are. Yeah. Yeah. But this boy was good and Leon's a well-school pianist. He's 90% bullshit but he's a good boy.
So how did you get started playing? Me?
